championships.name: HWE BIM Services Super One Series
championships.note: 12 rounds (6 double-header weekends), final round Shenington 29-30 Aug 2026. 2026 classes were Comer C50, MightE (Bambino/Cadet/Super Cadet), IAME M1, Honda Cadet, IAME Waterswift Restricted, Micro Max, Inter Max, Junior Rotax and Senior Rotax; no X30, TKM, KZ2 or OK standings were published for 2026. Points shown are after dropped scores. Team not listed (Alpha shows chassis only). Waterswift Restricted table has only 6 drivers.

championships.name: Wera Tools British Kart Championships (Motorsport UK)
championships.note: Official Motorsport UK British titles across the Rotax, IAME, KZ2 and Honda championships; season ended at Silverstone 8-10 Oct 2026. Points are after dropped scores, and team is the entrant. The E Plate tables are sub-classifications within the Rotax classes. No OK/OKJ British championship ran in 2026.

championships.name: Uptonsteel Motorsport UK Kartmasters British Kart Grand Prix
championships.note: A single event at PF International, 30 Jul to 2 Aug 2026, so there are no points. Rows are the Grand Prix final classification (top 10), and P1 wins the GP plate. Mini X30 replaced Waterswift at this event.

championships.note: The UK Rotax MAX Challenge series, run with JAG Rotax UK and a qualifier for the RMC Grand Finals. Six rounds, ending at Dunkeswell 26-27 Sep 2026. The separate Rotax Trophy at Silverstone (Oct 2026) and the RMC Grand Finals (Portimao, Nov 2026) are not included.

championships.name: National Kart Cup (NKC)
championships.note: Six rounds, ending at Clay Pigeon 12-13 Sep 2026. Only Rotax and Senior TKM classes ran; no IAME/X30 standings were published for 2026. Points are after dropped scores. Team not shown.

championships.name: The Kart Championship (TKC)
championships.note: Six rounds, ending at Whilton Mill 12-13 Sep 2026. The TKC Winter Cup and Autumn Cup are separate events and are not included. Points are after dropped scores. On Alpha Timing it is listed under the 'bkc' slug.

championships.name: Access Karting National Karting Series
championships.note: An independent (IKR) low-cost national series. Six rounds, ending with the Dragon Cup at Llandow 17-18 Oct 2026. Points are after dropped scores.

championships.name: UK Kart Series (UKKS)
championships.note: A national series for cadet and junior/Pro Kart classes. Nine rounds, ending at Shenington 31 Oct to 1 Nov 2026. The Senior Pro Kart, Formula Blue and T4 tables were not extracted. The Comer and IAME Bambino tables are short.

championships.name: TKM Festival
championships.note: No 2026 TKM Festival results were found online. Senior TKM is covered under the National Kart Cup.

championships.name: British Rental Kart Championship (BRKC)
championships.note: Single-weekend event at Formula Fast, Milton Keynes (early 2026). No points table; Grand Final order = championship top 10. Only the champion was confirmed (Formula Fast/BRKC social post 'Bernadowski BRKC Champion 2026'; first name from KWC ranking). Full Grand Final classification not found on brkc.co.uk. BRKC 2027 is 26–28 Feb 2027.

championships.name: British Indoor Karting Championship (BIKC)
championships.status: Regional Finals complete; National Final 14–15 Nov 2026
championships.note: Knockout format (qualifying → local → regional → national final), no points table. 2026 champions not yet decided. 2025 National Final results at https://bikc.co.uk/2025-results/ (e.g. HW Antony Wypych, MW Gabriel Quinta).

championships.name: British Universities Karting Championship (BUKC)
championships.note: Team championship (Club100 karts). Pts = counting score after drops; Southampton A champion on countback over Bath A (both 414). 2026/27 season starts with qualifiers 13–15 Nov 2026 at Whilton Mill.

championships.name: Sodi World Series – UK national ranking
championships.note: SWS rankings pages (sodiwseries.com/en-gb/rankings/) are behind reCAPTCHA; UK national Sprint Cup ranking could not be read. Ranking runs 1 Jan–31 Dec 2026.

championships.note: OK/Junior over 4 rounds (La Conca, Valencia, Mülsen, Kristianstad); KZ/KZ2 over 2 rounds (Genk, Sarno). Hoogendoorn and Drummond tied on 221 in OK. 'team' = nationality code.

OK & Junior at La Conca (ITA, 5-8 Nov 2026); KZ World Championship and KZ2 World Cup at Le Mans (FRA, 17-20 Sep 2026); OK-N World Cup at Viterbo (ITA, 11 Oct 2026). OK-N Junior winner was Niccolò Perico (FIA results page empty, not included). KZ 'team' = competitor team (nationality not shown in PDF).

championships.note: Rd1 Franciacorta (30 Aug) done; Rd2 Lonato 18-22 Nov and Rd3 Viterbo 25-29 Nov still to run. KZ2 only contests Rd2 and Rd3 (no KZ2 standings yet).

championships.note: OK-N, OK-N Junior, Mini 60. Round 4 Aspar (Sep) done; final Round 5 Franciacorta 13-15 Nov 2026. No standings table found online.
